channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Maria Bethânia faz o ‘L’ e declara: ‘Eu voto Lula presidente’
item.description: Maria Bethânia declared support for Lula during the Coala Festival in São Paulo, making an 'L' gesture with her hand and saying 'I vote Lula president.' The singer was the festival's main attraction, performing career hits.

item.title: Democracia en venta
item.description: Donald Trump proposed, during the Republican Convention in Dallas, to pay $5,000 to each of the 250 million Brazilian voters with suffrage if Republicans win the largest majority in the 2026 elections, a move interpreted as an attempt to buy an entire election. The proposal has sparked debates about campaign finance, political ethics, and electoral dynamics. Magazine articles and experts analyze the risks to democracy and a potential blue wave in the midterm elections.

item.title: La corrupción monopoliza el debate en la campaña electoral de Brasil
item.description: Brazil prepares for 2026 elections with corruption as the central issue, following Bolsonaro's conviction for conspiring against constitutional order. The debate is dominated by scandals similar to Lava Jato, with many familiar faces in the race.

item.title: Cuatro horas de deliberación para suspender el voto a miles de nacionalizados por la ‘ley de nietos’
item.description: The Spanish Supreme Court deliberated on precautionary measures regarding the 'grandchildren law', which may suspend the vote of thousands of naturalized citizens. Judge Luis Díez-Picazo spoke with Vox's legal coordinator, Jorge Buxadé, before the hearing. The case raises controversies over civil and electoral rights.

item.title: Nikolas cita moradia de Lulinha em Madri no último episódio de dossiê
item.description: Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) released the final episode of the 'Dossiê Lulinha' video series, which examines the residence of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva in Spain and raises questions about the costs and possible links to Federal Police investigations. The seven-part series discusses suspicions of influence peddling and fraud at INSS involving the president's son.

item.title: “Fomos penalizados pela primeira parte fraca que fizemos”: afirma Artur Jorge após derrota para o Santos
item.description: Artur Jorge stated that Cruzeiro's loss to Santos was due to a weak first half, highlighting defensive lapses and the high number of shots faced. The team remains in sixth place in the Brazilian Championship, far from the top four. Their next match is against Vitória at Barradão.

item.title: Flamengo x Corinthians: onde assistir, horário e prováveis escalações pelo Brasileirão
item.description: Flamengo and Corinthians face each other in the Brazilian Championship at Maracanã at 5:30 PM, with Flamengo leading the table and Corinthians seeking a recovery. Both teams are involved in the Copa Libertadores quarterfinals, which may influence the lineups.

item.title: Eleições 2026: qual é a ordem de votação? Veja como montar sua colinha e treinar em uma urna virtual
item.description: The 2026 elections in Brazil will begin on October 4th with a specific voting sequence on the electronic ballot, starting with federal deputy and ending with president. Voters can prepare using the Justice Electoral simulator, which reproduces the voting steps with fictional candidates. In the first round, voters will need to cast ballots for two senators, with two seats contested per state.

item.title: Governadores do Brasil: quem governa cada estado e até quando vai o mandato
item.description: In 2026, Brazilians will vote on October 4th to elect governors and vice-governors across all 27 federative units, with a potential runoff on October 25th. The inauguration of the elected officials is scheduled for January 6th, 2027. Many current governors took office following the departure of incumbents who ran for other positions, with terms extending until the swearing-in of the newly elected.

item.title: Prioridade para PT e PL, votação para o Senado tem mais votos brancos e nulos que para presidente e governador
item.description: The 2026 Senate election faces high rates of blank and null votes, higher than in presidential and gubernatorial races. The PL and PT compete for the 54 contested seats with strategic focus, especially to influence STF decisions. The large number of voters not directly voting for a senator reflects the complexity and lack of knowledge about majority voting.

item.title: Em semana de convocação, goleiro da Seleção comenta atuação em derrota: “Chateado”
item.description: Goalkeeper Otávio commented on his performance after Cruzeiro's defeat to Santos, expressing disappointment with the result but satisfaction with his own play. He was recently called up for the first time to the Brazilian national team by manager Carlo Ancelotti.

item.title: Santos vence o Cruzeiro e soma mais três pontos no Brasileirão
item.description: Santos defeated Cruzeiro 2-1 at home in the 27th round of the Brazilian Championship, with goals from Rollheiser and an own goal by Fabrício Bruno. The win moved Santos to 35 points, temporarily in 10th place, while Cruzeiro, with 42 points, stayed in sixth. The victory marked São Paulo FC's second consecutive win in the league.

item.title: Enquanto Rock in Rio recebe Maroon 5 pela quinta vez, São Paulo canta Maria Bethânia
item.description: Maria Bethânia captivated the Coala Festival audience with a political and engaging performance, contrasting the repetitive act of Maroon 5 at Rock in Rio. The singer performed her hits and openly supported Lula, while the American band stuck to their formula without innovation. The stark difference in impact highlights the audience’s preference for authenticity and engagement.

item.title: Foragida da Justiça brasileira, Carla Zambelli ajuda a comandar campanha da mãe à Câmara
item.description: Carla Zambelli, wanted by Brazilian justice and facing extradition proceedings in Italy, is active in her mother Rita Zambelli's campaign for the Chamber of Deputies in São Paulo.

item.title: Mesmo com um a mais, Botafogo fica só no empate com o Bragantino pelo Campeonato Brasileiro
item.description: Botafogo and Bragantino drew in the Brazilian Championship, even with the home team playing with one extra player in the second half. The result extends Botafogo's winless streak to five matches in the tournament.

item.title: Advogado de Marçal alega “injustiça” por TSE barrar candidatura
item.description: The TSE rejected Pablo Marçal's presidential candidacy due to lack of timely affiliation proof to the PRTB and ineligibility. His lawyer, Tassio Renam, called the decision unjust, citing retroactive affiliation and the Filia system suspension. Marçal remains ineligible until 2032.

item.title: Decisão de Fachin sobre relatoria do caso Moraes teve acordo com Mendonça; veja bastidor
item.description: The STF president, Edson Fachin, took over the rapporteurship of the case involving Minister Alexandre de Moraes following an agreement with former rapporteur André Mendonça. The transfer was formalized via a order from Mendonça, who returned the case to the presidency, maintaining the trial by the full court. The measure surprised interlocutors within the Court, particularly regarding the scope of the request for documents from cases under Mendonça's rapporteurship.

item.title: Fachin dá 24 horas para PF explicar situação de celular de Vorcaro
item.description: The president of the STF, Edson Fachin, ordered the Federal Police to explain within 24 hours the situation of the phone of former banker Daniel Vorcaro, including storage conditions. Justices such as Gilmar Mendes, Cristiano Zanin, and Alexandre de Moraes request full access to the device's content, while Minister André Mendonça states the phone is sealed and has not been handled. The dispute centers on sharing data among Supreme Court justices for case analysis.

item.title: Renan Santos chama Flávio de “bandido” e “vassalo de Trump”
item.description: Renan Santos labeled Flávio Bolsonaro a 'bandit' and 'Trump vassal' during a debate, alleging ties to the Rockbridge Network and indirect foreign funding. He claimed campaign members had contact with U.S.-based groups interested in Brazilian business ventures, such as Vulcan, but provided no concrete evidence. He urged journalists to investigate the claims rather than filing formal complaints with electoral authorities.

item.title: Renan Santos critica bolsonarismo em SC e defende pena de 30 anos para assalto à mão armada
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão candidate for president, criticized bolsonarismo in Santa Catarina during a campaign event in Joinville, calling for stronger action against supporters of Carlos Bolsonaro and advocating for harsher sentences for armed crimes. He also proposed revising the fiscal pact, setting management targets for governors and mayors, and public funding for police monitoring systems.

item.title: Fachin tira relatoria de Mendonça e assume caso ligado a Moraes e Vorcaro
item.description: The president of the STF, Edson Fachin, removed the rapporteurship of the Master case from André Mendonça and forwarded the process to the presidency of the Court, due to the crisis between the ministers. The case involves messages between Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro, and is suspended until a new decision.

item.title: Ziyech é apresentado à torcida do Botafogo antes de partida no Nilton Santos
item.description: Hakim Ziyech was officially introduced to the Botafogo fans before the match against Red Bull Bragantino in the 27th round of the 2026 Brazilian Championship. The Moroccan forward signed a contract valid until December 2028, but has no set date for his debut, needing time to adapt to the team. His signing marks the player's first experience in Brazilian football, following his standout performance in the 2022 FIFA World Cup.

item.title: Chuva de desfalques: Corinthians terá redução importante de jogadores contra o Flamengo
item.description: Corinthians faces a significant reduction of players for the match against Flamengo, with absences due to suspension, injury, and load management. The team, in crisis with four consecutive losses, may field a weakened lineup to preserve players for the upcoming Libertadores match against Estudiantes. Fernando Diniz chose to rest some athletes, worsening the situation in the Brazilian league.

item.title: Dirceu defende investigação sobre ministros do STF e pacto de Lula na crise
item.description: José Dirceu, a former PT minister, advocates that Lula act as a guarantor to resolve the STF crisis by promoting investigations into ministers. He reinforces support for the president amid internal and external pressures.

item.title: Vitor Roque marca, Palmeiras bate o São Paulo e retoma a liderança
item.description: Palmeiras defeated São Paulo 2-0 with goals from Murilo and Vitor Roque, reclaiming the lead in the Brazilian Championship during the 27th round. São Paulo played with reserves and had a player sent off in the first half.

item.title: Fachin assume relatoria de procedimento que envolve Moraes após Mendonça enviar processo
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin took over the reporting of a case involving Minister Alexandre de Moraes after André Mendonça forwarded it for analysis of messages between Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro. Fachin also ordered that investigations into the Master and INSS pension fraud be sent to the STF Presidency. The decision aims to enable the hearing scheduled for Tuesday, when it will be assessed whether there are grounds to investigate Moraes.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 66,4% contra 25,6% de Lula no 2º turno em RR
item.description: An AtlasIntel survey released on September 11, 2026 shows that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) leads with 66.4% of voting intentions in Roraima against 25.6% for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the simulated second round. In all three second-round scenarios tested, Lula is defeated. The survey interviewed 1,200 voters between September 4 and 9, with a margin of error of 3 percentage points.

item.title: FLÁVIO conquista o NORDESTE e LULA falha em SUBIR no SUDESTE: SITUAÇÃO PIORA para a ESQUERDA
item.description: Flávio Dino gains strong support in the Northeast, while Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva struggles to improve his performance in the Southeast. This situation reflects a strategic setback for the Brazilian left in the polls.

item.title: Os números de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro em Pernambuco, segundo nova pesquisa
item.description: A Datafolha survey released on September 12 shows Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading with 55% of voting intentions in Pernambuco, ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 24%. Lula's advantage widens when considering only valid votes, reaching 62% against 27%. In the simulated runoff, Lula maintains a strong lead with 61% of preferences.

item.title: PT pede ao STF investigação de possível financiamento de organização trumpista para Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The PT requested the STF to open an investigation into alleged illegal donations from an organization linked to U.S. Vice President J.D. Vance to Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign. The Rockbridge Network, founded by Vance, is suspected of irregularly funding the election bid of the son of the former Brazilian president. The case involves corruption allegations and illegal campaign financing.

item.title: Lula joga aliados no ventilador
item.description: The lifting of the judicial secrecy in the Master case reignited Lula's electoral campaign, which had been tied with Flávio Bolsonaro in the polls. Without sparing allies, the president used the maneuver to reposition himself and catch his breath in the electoral race.

item.title: Nova pesquisa mostra os números de Lula e Flávio no Distrito Federal
item.description: A new Datafolha poll in the Federal District shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading with 40% and Lula (PT) at 32% in the first-round projection. Flávio's lead fluctuated slightly compared to the previous survey but remains within the margin of error. In the second round, Flávio holds 51% against Lula's 39%.

item.title: Voz moderna da música argentina, Milo J é recebido com entusiasmo no Rock in Rio
item.description: Milo J, a 19-year-old Argentine singer, thrilled the audience at Rock in Rio 2026 with an acoustic and folk-inspired performance at the Supernova Stage. While traditionally labeled a 'rapper,' his show blended Argentine folk elements with a modern, almost tribal sound. Hits like 'Bajo de la piel,' 'Niño,' and 'Rara vez' earned him an enthusiastic reception, highlighting his emotional connection with the Brazilian crowd.

item.title: Como está a disputa entre Lula e Flávio no Rio de Janeiro, segundo nova pesquisa
item.description: New Datafolha poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading Lula (PT) in Rio de Janeiro, with 39% versus 35%. The gap is four percentage points, within a three-point margin of error. Cury rises to 5%, while Pablo Marçal does not significantly change the race.

item.title: Datafolha no DF: Flávio tem 40% e Lula, 32% no 1º turno
item.description: A Datafolha poll in the Federal District shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading with 40% in the first round, followed by Lula (PT) with 32%. In a second-round scenario, Bolsonaro would have 51% against Lula's 39%. Ronaldo Caiado ranks third with 8%.

item.title: O prazo de Fachin para a PF apresentar informações sobre o celular de Vorcaro
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin gave the Federal Police 24 hours to provide details on the raw data from Daniel Vorcaro's phone. Ministers demanded access ahead of Tuesday's session; Mendonça claimed he never handled the original data. The dispute centers on messages exchanged between Vorcaro and Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: No jogo de ida das semifinais do Brasileirão Feminino, São Paulo vence de virada o Flamengo
item.description: In the first leg of the Brazilian Women's Championship semifinals, São Paulo defeated Flamengo 3-1 with a comeback in the second half. Despite hosting, Flamengo could not withstand São Paulo's pressure in the final stage.

item.title: Os números milionários de 'Dark Horse' que Flávio Bolsonaro prometeu a Vorcaro: cachê de 'Oppenheimer', bilheteria da Zendaya
item.description: PF documents show Flavio Bolsonaro promised Vorcaro a US$4M fee for Jim Caviezel in 'Dark Horse', with US$12.3M actually paid. The budget sheet contrasts sharply with Brazilian market norms, reinforcing suspicions of financing irregularities. Fachin's order made Bank Master case files public.

item.title: Datafolha mostra Flávio à frente de Lula em São Paulo
item.description: A Datafolha poll released Saturday shows Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading Lula (PT) in the presidential race in São Paulo. In a hypothetical runoff, Flávio leads with 47% against Lula's 42%. The result signals growing Bolsonarista support in Brazil's largest electoral college.

item.title: Datafolha: Flávio tem 49% e Lula, 41% no 2º turno no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: In Rio de Janeiro, Flávio Bolsonaro leads Lula 49% to 41% in a runoff, though their ranges overlap within the 3-point margin of error. In the first round, Flávio has 39% and Lula 35%, a 4-point lead beyond the margin; the poll surveyed 1,204 voters.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 59,1% contra 35,2% de Lula no 2º turno no MT
item.description: An AtlasIntel poll of 1,209 voters, with a three-percentage-point margin of error, projects Flávio Bolsonaro defeating Lula in Mato Grosso's second round by 59.1% to 35.2%. Romeu Zema, Ronaldo Caiado and Renan Santos also lead Lula, although the Renan Santos scenario has a high share of blank, null or undeclared votes.

item.title: Datafolha: Flávio tem 35%, Lula, 33%, e Cury, 7% no 1º turno em SP
item.description: In the first-round presidential poll for São Paulo, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has 35% of intent-to-vote support, followed by Lula (PT) with 33%. Augusto Cury (Avante) rose from 3% to 7%, while Renan Santos (Missão) reached 6%; the supplied Datafolha excerpt does not identify the office in the simulated race.

item.title: Datafolha em PE: Lula lidera com 61% no 2º turno; Flávio tem 30%
item.description: According to Datafolha in Pernambuco, Lula (PT) leads with 61% over Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 30% in a potential runoff, with stable numbers compared to the previous survey. In the first round, Lula has 55% and Flávio 24% of voting intentions, with a margin of error of three percentage points.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Douglas Ruas são recebidos por filho de Garotinho em ato em Campos
item.description: Wladimir Garotinho welcomed Flávio Bolsonaro and Douglas Ruas in Campos dos Goytacazes, Rio de Janeiro, joining a PL caravan in the Norte Fluminense region. Flávio emphasized public security and food prices, while the event highlighted the political split between Wladimir and Anthony Garotinho's group.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro têm empate técnico no 2º turno em MG
item.description: In a hypothetical second round in Minas Gerais, Lula (46%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (45%) are in a statistical tie, with a 3-point margin of error. In the first round, Lula leads with 37% over Flávio's 35%, but the gap narrowed from six to two points compared to the previous poll.

item.title: Produtora de Dark Horse pagou R$ 136 mil em faturas de Mario Frias
item.description: Go Up Entertainment, producer of the film 'Dark Horse', paid R$136,800 in credit card bills of federal deputy Mário Frias (PL-SP) between August and November 2025. Frias serves as screenwriter and executive producer of the film, while Go Up, based in the U.S., is the official production house. The payments surfaced during a Federal Police investigation into suspected misuse of congressional amendments, flagging potential corruption crimes involving public funds allocated to the movie.

item.title: Datafolha: mais de 80% dizem que crise no STF não alterou voto para presidente
item.description: Datafolha survey shows 85% of respondents did not change their presidential vote after the STF crisis involving Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro. The crisis had little impact on voting intentions, with 86% keeping their decision following the request to investigate André Mendonça. The study also reveals 71% consider the STF essential to protecting democracy.

item.title: Atlético-MG aproveita ‘apagão’ do Fluminense e vence em casa pelo Brasileirão; veja os gols
item.description: Atlético-MG defeated Fluminense 3-1 at Arena MRV in the 27th round of the Brasileirão, with goals from Reinier, Cuello, and Vitão. The Galo capitalized on the opponent's disorganization in the second half to climb to seventh place with 39 points, while Fluminense remains in fourth with 45 points.

item.title: Datafolha: veja os números das pesquisas presidenciais em SP, RJ, MG, PE e DF
item.description: Datafolha polling shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading in SP, RJ, and DF, while Lula (PT) leads in MG and PE in the first round. The two main candidates are statistically tied in most of the states surveyed. The study, commissioned by Globo and Folha de S.Paulo, interviewed voters between September 8 and 10 with a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Avaliação positiva de Lula vai de 46% em PE a 25% em SP, mostra Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on Dec 12, 2026 shows Lula's approval ranging from 46% in Pernambuco to 25% in São Paulo among five surveyed states. In PE, 46% rate his government as good/excellent vs 31% bad/terrible; in SP the trend reverses. The survey highlights significant regional divergence in presidential approval.
